notes.title: 'The age of gameplay mechanics has already passed' says Shadow of The Colossus director as he praises Katamari Damacy creator's new game for not being systems-driven
notes.content: Katamari Damacy creator Keita Takahashi is known for making unusual games, and his latest digital escapade To a T is no different. Players assume the role of a teenager stuck in a T-pose as they try to navigate everyday life via interactive scenes like brushing their teeth and eating breakfast... Read more.

notes.title: To A T review
notes.content: In To a T you eventually find out exactly why Teen (the 13-year-old kid you play) is forever stuck in a T-pose, arms protruding stiffly out from their sides at all times. The reveal does not disappoint. When I learned why Teen was T-shaped, I asked a few of my coworkers if I could please spoil it for them just because I desperately needed to talk about it with somebody. Anybody... Read more.

notes.title: to a T has a demo - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Can you believe to a T is almost upon us. Wow. 

Ahead of our launch on May 28, to give you a sneak preview of what adventures teen and dog will get up to, we are excited to announce that a demo of the first chapter of to a T is OUT NOW and your save progress will transfer over to the final game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727290/to_a_T_Demo 
Give it a go and tell your friends, neighbors, and local giraffes. Speaking of giraffes, we are also happy to share that you can now listen to [url=https://social.tunecore.com/linkShare?linkid=sqwwoGAmx850yjYtNIG8aQ]Giraffe Song by Rebecca Sugar wherever you go as it is now streaming on digital music platforms. [/url]

That’s all for now, see you on May 28.
